# Tomato ISA v1 — ASSEMBLER VOCABULARY (: # Why bother: the CPU only has BEQ / BNE / BLT / BGE and a separate CMP
# ordinary intent ("branch if this register is zero"
# "branch if less or equal") reads as two unrelated lines. Naming those shapes
# makes the OS source say what it means.
#   form      operand shape; $1..$3 are the operands in order
#   expands   one or more real instructions
#   words     how many instruction words it assembles to
#   flags     does the expansion disturb the flags (yes/no/sets)
#   @+N       absolute address of (first word of this expansion) + N. Used to
#             branch over the next instruction without inventing a label.
